Talent0_2Ability.name: Fearless Hunting Fang
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When attacked and dragged into combat from within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles and both hands are intact, activates <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill> after combat. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block melee attack.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Fearless Hunting Fang
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When attacked and dragged into combat from within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles and both hands are intact, activates <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill> after combat. <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can additionally block melee attack.
While [Zoey] is on the field, enemies inflicted with <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> take <color=#F74848>15%</color> more DMG from [Zoey] and deal <color=#F74848>15%</color> less DMG to units other than [Zoey].

600001.name: Entrenched 1
600001.SpecificEffects: Trigger <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> to protect adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) allies from Assault and Ranged attacks, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

601102.name: Parry
601102.SpecificEffects: When both arms are intact, DMG taken on arms are reduced by <color=#F74848>25%</color>.

601103.name: Ambush
601103.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. When being retaliated against, gains <color=#F74848>20%</color> Dodge Rate.

601104.name: First Strike
601104.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack all targets within an I-shaped (3x1-tile) or L-shaped (3x1-tile) area ahead, dealing <color=#F74848>0.9x</color> AoE DMG. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=6011042>[Advantage]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks.

601105.name: Seizing Momentum
601105.SpecificEffects: When completely dodging an attack, recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601106.name: Flash Hunt
601106.describe: Uses Polearm to <range type=1>thrust 4 tiles forward</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.7x</color> DMG to the <color=#F74848>1st</color> target hit and applies <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

601107.name: Chaotic Steps
601107.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>1</color> enemies carrying <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf>, Dodge Rate increases by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>12%</color>.

601108.name: Verdict
601108.describe: Selects an empty tile within <range type=0>4-adjacent</range> tiles, jumps to the target type and uses Polearm to deal <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> AoE DMG to all enemies within <range type=1>2-adjacent</range> tiles of the target, inflicting <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> on all enemies hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

600022.name: Armor Specialization 2
600022.SpecificEffects: When performing <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

601131.name: Survival Instinct 1
601131.SpecificEffects: When attacked, if a Dodge is triggered, recovers <color=#F74848>4%</color> max HP to all undestroyed parts. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> hit dodged, additionally recovers <color=#F74848>1%</color> more HP, up to <color=#F74848>8%</color> additional HP.

600033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
600033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

601134.name: Survival Instinct 2
601134.SpecificEffects: When completely dodging an attack, <buf ID=6011311>[Survival Instinct 1]</buf> effect can additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part.

601135.name: Survival Instinct 3
601135.SpecificEffects: When attacked and HP dropped below <color=#F74848>50%</color> of max HP, gains <buf ID=1008062>[Absolute Dodge]</buf> after combat. This effect has a <color=#F74848>3</color> turns CD.

601136.name: Survival Instinct 4
601136.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=6011311>[Survival Instinct 1]</buf> after-combat recovery increases to <color=#F74848>10%</color> HP for all undestroyed parts.

601141.name: Hunting Impulse 1
601141.SpecificEffects: After using <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill> for <color=#F74848>3</color> times, the next active attack will not consume AP. Can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allowing movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. This effect is removed after triggering.

600043.name: Entrenched 4
600043.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can now be triggered an unlimited number of times per turn.

601145.name: Hunting Impulse 3
601145.SpecificEffects: After activating <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill>, applies <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> to all targets hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

601146.name: Hunting Impulse 4
601146.SpecificEffects: <skill activeSkill=6011501>[Polearm Throw]</skill> DMG dealt increases to <color=#F74848>1x</color> AoE DMG.

hiddenSkills.name: Rear Guard
hiddenSkills.describe: Protects allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles from assault and ranged attacks, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Additionally inflicts <buf ID=6011014>[Provocation]</buf> on all enemies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
